name: NGC 6744A (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 6744A, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc6744a-hubble
story: A small irregular galaxy lying along the spiral arms of NGC 6744, the larger galaxy it accompanies. Hubble visited it as part of a census of the satellite galaxies that circle Milky Way-like systems.

claims.text: NGC 6744A is an irregular galaxy (type IB(s)m) to the northwest of NGC 6744, near 19h 09m, -63 44'
NGC 6744A is a dwarf satellite of NGC 6744 lying along its spiral arms
DW1908M6343 is a target of Hubble program 18061, a census of satellite galaxies around Milky Way-like systems
